title: Assessments
lead: Browse assessment categories. Open an assessment to complete it. Content is available to admin accounts, or with an access code.

categories.title: Lunez Massage
categories.description: Knowledge and application assessments for Lunez Massage.

assessments.title: Lunez Massage Assessment 1
assessments.summary: 20 questions: 10 applied, 5 fill-in-the-gap, 5 article-reading checks. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read The Lunez Massage
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Wellness Therapist understands the purpose, technique, timing, benefits, client expectation management, consent, hygiene, boundaries, safety and professional mindset required for Lunez Massage.

assessments.summary: 20 questions: 10 applied, 5 fill-in-the-gap, 5 article-reading checks. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.

assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Wellness Therapist understands and can apply the Mode of Address Standard: professional identity, leadership titles without superiority, Client + name internally, respectful direct address, tone matching the word, friendship without carelessness, correction without humiliation, and consistent dignity for every person.

categories.title: Poverty Mindset

assessments.summary: 20 questions: 10 applied, 5 fill-in-the-gap, 5 article-reading checks. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read the Poverty Mindset issue
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Wellness Therapist can distinguish lack from scarcity identity, respond when a client says “poverty mindset,” correct service errors without absorbing a humiliating label, refuse harsh personal judgment professionally, and interrupt jealousy, envy, gossip, inferiority, and need-driven service.

categories.title: Understanding Team Work
categories.description: Knowledge assessments for the Staff Teamwork Training Programme.

assessments.title: Day 1 Knowledge Assessment
assessments.summary: 5 questions on the meaning and importance of teamwork. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1: Meaning and Importance of Teamwork
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands what teamwork is, how it differs from merely working in the same place, which behaviours build or damage trust, and how to offer appropriate help without abandoning their own duties.

assessments.title: Day 1 Lesson 3 Knowledge Assessment
assessments.summary: 5 questions on shared goals, individual duties and accountability. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1 Lesson 3: Shared Goals and Responsibilities
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands shared goals versus individual responsibilities, who owns assigned duties, when to communicate blockers, and how to support colleagues without encouraging dependency.

assessments.title: Day 1 Lesson 4 Workplace Attitude Exercise
assessments.summary: 4 situations on how you would respond at work. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1 Lesson 4: How Individual Attitudes Affect Team Performance
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member chooses professional responses to correction, a colleague's success, frustration, and a struggling teammate — without gossip, hostility, or neglect.

assessments.title: Day 1 Lesson 5 Ego or Team-First Exercise
assessments.summary: 5 situations on whether you choose ego or a team-first response. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1 Lesson 5: Putting Team Success Above Personal Ego
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can put team success above personal ego: consider ideas on merit, celebrate colleagues, own mistakes, share knowledge, and raise disagreement respectfully.

assessments.title: Day 2 Lesson 1 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on workplace respect toward colleagues, supervisors and management. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 2 Lesson 1: Respecting Colleagues, Supervisors and Management
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands workplace respect: treating people with dignity, correcting without humiliation, raising disagreement professionally, and applying respect in every direction — including supervisors and management.

assessments.title: Day 2 Lesson 2 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on workplace boundaries with colleagues, supervisors and clients. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 2 Lesson 2: Understanding Workplace Boundaries
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands workplace boundaries: respectful limits with colleagues, privacy with supervisors, and professional boundaries with clients — including declining inappropriate sexual requests.

assessments.title: Day 2 Lesson 3 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on gossip, mockery, cliques and unhealthy competition. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 2 Lesson 3: Avoiding Gossip, Mockery, Cliques and Unhealthy Competition
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can distinguish gossip from legitimate reporting, correct without mockery, recognise unhealthy cliques, compete fairly, and refuse to spread rumours.

assessments.title: Day 2 Lesson 4 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on remaining courteous during disagreement. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 2 Lesson 4: Being Courteous Even When You Disagree
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can disagree respectfully: listen before responding, ask for clarification, stay calm under frustration, accept a better option, and pause a heated discussion.

assessments.title: Day 2 Lesson 5 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on separating personal feelings from professional responsibilities. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 2 Lesson 5: Separating Personal Feelings from Professional Responsibilities
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can manage emotions at work: cooperate despite personal dislike, seek help when distressed, apply standards fairly, and practise emotional maturity.

assessments.title: Day 2 Lesson 6 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on workplace confidentiality, client privacy and responsible reporting. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 2 Lesson 6: Maintaining Confidentiality
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands confidentiality: protecting client identity and records, not using client contacts for personal purposes, reporting accidental disclosures, and reporting misconduct rather than concealing it.

assessments.title: Day 3 Lesson 1 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on speaking politely and choosing appropriate words. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 3 Lesson 1: Speaking Politely and Choosing Appropriate Words
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can communicate politely: correct without personal attacks, decline extra work respectfully, respond to client complaints courteously, and apply the CLEAR method.

assessments.title: Day 3 Lesson 2 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on listening without interrupting. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 3 Lesson 2: Listening Without Interrupting
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands active listening: hearing the full message, clarifying unclear instructions, listening during disagreement, and interrupting only for urgent safety.

assessments.title: Day 3 Lesson 4 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on asking questions instead of making assumptions. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 3 Lesson 4: Asking Questions Instead of Making Assumptions
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can distinguish facts from assumptions, clarify booking and task details, ask without blaming, and apply the CHECK method.

assessments.title: Day 3 Lesson 5 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on giving and receiving instructions. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 3 Lesson 5: Giving and Receiving Instructions
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can give and receive instructions clearly: clarify when unsure, resolve conflicting assignments, report delays, and confirm understanding rather than only saying okay.

assessments.title: Day 3 Lesson 6 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on communicating concerns to the right person. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 3 Lesson 6: Communicating Concerns to the Right Person
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can report concerns through the right channel: distinguish complaining from reporting, escalate when a supervisor is involved, communicate facts, and follow up on unresolved issues.

assessments.title: Day 3 Lesson 7 Knowledge Check
assessments.summary: 5 questions on appropriate communication in staff WhatsApp groups. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 3 Lesson 7: Appropriate Communication in Staff WhatsApp Groups
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can use staff WhatsApp groups professionally: keep messages relevant, acknowledge instructions, handle disagreements privately, and apply the THINK method.
